title: Best Washing Machines UK
short: Washing machines compared by drum size, spin speed and noise, from budget picks to premium integrated models.
intro: Drum size and spin speed matter more than brand name for how well a washing machine fits your household. This guide compares machines picked by Mumsnet's panel, spanning budget, quiet, premium and large-capacity options.

products.name: WGG24400GB
products.summary: Mumsnet's overall winner. Quiet Mark certified with good stain removal, and its Speed Perfect function cuts wash time by up to 65%, though spin performance is less effective on quick washes.
pros: Speed Perfect cuts wash time by up to 65%
cons: Less effective spin performance on quick washes

products.name: EnergySpin BM3WT4941IW
products.best_for: Affordable families who want strong energy efficiency
products.summary: Excellent value with a 28-minute quick wash and claimed energy savings of up to 35%, though the reduced spin speed can leave clothes damper than higher-spin rivals.
cons: Reduced spin speed leaves clothes damper

products.name: F4Y510WBLN1
products.summary: A Direct Drive motor minimises noise, making it well suited to open-plan living or washing at night, with a 39-minute TurboWash cycle and a pause-and-add feature, though it's not the fastest spin speed here.

products.name: WWD380WCS
products.best_for: Buyers who want a long-term investment piece
products.summary: Mumsnet's premium pick, tested by Miele for 20 years of use with exceptional build quality, a steam care system and a gentler honeycomb drum, though the upfront cost is high.

products.name: Series 8 AI Energy WW11DB8B95GBU1
products.summary: The largest drum here, with a dedicated bedding cycle, ecobubble technology and a hygiene steam mode that removes 99.9% of bacteria, though the touchscreen can be activated accidentally.

products.name: 3S Series WF3S8043BW
products.best_for: Budget-conscious households who prioritise running costs
products.summary: Ultra-quiet at 72dB with a powerful Jet Wash function, a 15-minute quick cycle and app connectivity, though it lacks a dedicated handwash or delicates cycle.

products.name: H-Wash HBWOS 69TAMCE-80
products.best_for: Kitchens that need a built-in, hidden washing machine
products.summary: Good energy efficiency for an integrated model, with multiple quick wash options and excellent value, though the detergent drawer can be awkward to access and it uses a full touchscreen.
pros: Good energy efficiency for an integrated model

guide.q: What drum size do I need?
guide.a: As a rough guide, 7-8kg suits one or two people, 9kg suits a typical family, and 10-11kg or more suits a larger household or anyone who wants to wash bedding and towels in fewer loads.

A higher spin speed (1400-1600rpm) extracts more water before drying, which shortens tumble dryer time or air-drying time. It's less important if you mostly line-dry delicate items, which usually use a lower spin setting anyway.

guide.q: How much does washing machine noise matter?
guide.a: If your machine is in or near a kitchen or living space, or you want to run it at night, a quieter machine, like the LG here with its Direct Drive motor, or one carrying Quiet Mark certification, makes a noticeable difference to daily life.

guide.q: Is an integrated washing machine worth it?
guide.a: Integrated machines hide behind a cabinet door for a seamless kitchen look, but installation is more involved and repairs can be slightly more awkward to access. A freestanding machine is simpler to install, move and service.
